[{"body":"Review of exact HEAD `cc1e214d8fdeea9644a261305b26f38469ce4b59`: the earlier confirmatory-closure and Method-completeness P1s are fixed, as is unique admitted-Skill counting. Those results bind the original base `11c3b57`.

One bounded P2 remains before freezing this shared contract.

### [P2] Align the A3 comparison subset with the A4 overlay's Task

`validate_qualification()` deliberately closes A3 over every frozen Manifest Task, and `validate_comparability()` requires its A3 runtime bindings to cover that whole qualification. `validate_overlay()` instead closes A4 over the single exact `overlay.task_ref`. The final call compares `comparison_surface(a3)` for all Tasks directly with that one-Task A4 surface.

The existing Manifest supports multiple frozen Tasks, and the new requirement-closure helper explicitly accepts separate Tasks. In that case, unrelated A3 Task rows necessarily introduce `tasks`/binding multiplicity differences; `derive_comparability()` returns `not-comparable` / `unavailable` even for a valid comparison of the overlay's own Task. The caller cannot pass only that Task's A3 bindings because the current all-qualification Snapshot coverage check rejects it.

A bounded probe reused the fully validated current single-Task synthetic A3/A4 fixture (two requirements, one admitted extension, `skill-bearing-package`). It added a second Task to the in-memory A3 demand closure, which the existing `validate_requirement_closure()` accepted. The current comparison then returned `not-comparable`; selecting A3 by the overlay's exact Task FileRef restored the identical original package-effect result/digest. This isolates the helper/reducer composition; it is **not** a complete multi-Task disk-chain or research execution test. No subprocess, model or full suite ran.

Please keep full A3 qualification and Method/Requirement completeness, but compare the exact Task/case selected by the A4 overlay against the corresponding A3 subset. Verify that subset's completeness and add one focused multi-Task composition regression. Reuse the existing Task pin; no new Schema, Harness, Runtime behavior or exact-skill-only promise is required.

### Integration with newly accepted PR68

Develop is now `1cb0c19`. There is one real merge conflict in `docs/implementation/README.md`: retain PR68's M5-003 non-executing label and add the M5-006 link. Also update the inherited paragraphs/navigation claiming that only M5-003 is implemented and M5-006 is pending; keep M6-008, Skill replay, Harness, real-case/live/admission gates explicit. The old successful target cannot represent this unresolved new-base integration.

After these narrow corrections, validate the affected regression and the final candidate's existing CI obligations. No extra full-suite policy, witness, installation/model experiment or performance threshold is requested. M4 stays closed; the current Method difference continues to produce a package effect, and M5-006 does not grant execution/admission authority or complete downstream tasks.
